verdict.rationale: Jira has its own documented mechanisms that let tools and agents share work context. These include an official MCP server that lets agents read and write Jira work, rich APIs with REST/JQL querying praised by users, Rovo AI connecting assets from Confluence, Figma and third-party apps to issues, and Trello sync and automation that keep tools in step. However, the evidence never describes an explicit handoff between agents or tools that guarantees context is preserved. missing for 10: documented agent-to-agent or tool-to-tool handoff workflow with context preservation, depth of the MCP server's capabilities, independent hands-on corroboration of lossless handoffs, machine-readable discovery (llms.txt/OpenAPI probes returned 404).
